what: Eight wires curve from upper right to lower left and gather into a bundle at 16px spacing — painted accent→lime only inside a section (band), and outside it they continue as faint lines at 5% of the text color up into the section above. Painted strands breathe .8~1 in turn on a 5.2s cycle (each strand .085 later), and over them two 32px comet tails travel down the strands for 1~2 seconds with quadratic easeInOut, fading over the first 18% and last 22%. After one pass they rest .9~3.2 seconds, then pass again on another empty strand in one color of orange · purple · sky · pink. Paused when off screen

options.comets: Number of comets orbiting at once, default 2
options.y-in · y-out: Height at which the comet enters and exits (viewBox 848×868), default 200 · 880
options.band: Horizontal range element to paint — a selector chosen inside the section that holds the attached svg. If empty, the whole section

note: Empty <svg> When attached, it draws strands in a viewBox of 848×868. The position (large, bleeding out to the right and bottom) and the soft edge mask are given to the svg by the using side’s css. With reduced motion, only the painted strands stop at .82

from.where: shared.js .m-cta__wires (The knowledge platform built for agents CTA band)
